Stage.LogText: {=sp_kb_s1_log}You received an urgent, blood-stained message from a pigeon. Your friend {Dost_Link} needs to see you immediately. Find him and ask what the emergency is.

{=sp_kb_s2_log}You spoke to {Dost_Link}. He revealed that the artisan {HainZanaatkar_Link} is a traitor who stole the Pigeon ciphers and fled. To find his main convoy, you must first intercept and defeat 3 of his decoy looter parties roaming the lands.
{=sp_kb_s3_log}After defeating the decoys, the traitor's massive convoy has appeared to eliminate you! Confront them and retrieve the ciphers.

{=sp_kb_success_log}You destroyed the convoy and executed the traitor {HainZanaatkar_Link}. The ciphers were returned to {Dost_Link}, and your absolute loyalty to the Scavenger Pigeons has been proven once and for all.

{=sp_kb_yozlasma_log}You accepted the traitor's bribe. You let {HainZanaatkar_Link} escape to a rival kingdom with the ciphers. You are richer and now wield the Pigeon's Secret Dagger, but you have betrayed the Motherland. {Dost_Link} remains unaware of your corruption.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_kb_dlg1}I received your bloody pigeon message. What is the emergency?
{=sp_kb_dlg2}It's a disaster, my friend! The artisan, {HainZanaatkar_Link}... The one who gave you the fake assassination order. He wasn't just playing a role. He's a real double agent!

{=sp_kb_dlg4}He stole our master ciphers and fled the city. He's planning to sell them to the enemy. He hired a massive mercenary army disguised as looters to escort him. We must stop him before he crosses the border!
{=sp_kb_dlg6}Hunt down his decoy looter parties. Destroy three of them. This will force his main convoy out of hiding. I am counting on you, Pigeon.
{=sp_kb_dlg7}So, {PlayerName}... You actually found me. I am {HainZanaatkar.Name}. You Pigeons are truly relentless.
{=sp_kb_dlg8}Give me the ciphers, traitor. Your death will be quick.

{=sp_kb_dlg9}Wait! You blindly fight for 'Dost' and the Motherland. Do you even know what these ciphers contain? They are false-flag assassination orders to start an unjustified war! The Motherland is corrupt, my friend. Let me go, and I will give you a fortune and my legendary dagger.
{=sp_kb_dlg10}The lies of a traitor mean nothing to me. Men, attack! (Fight)
{=sp_kb_dlg11}A false-flag war? Hand over the gold and the dagger, and get out of my sight.
{=sp_kb_dlg12}A wise choice. The Pigeons are Fools. Farewell, {PlayerName}.
